title: Catalyst — Worker Event Stream Tail
description: Loki-only forensic tail of the worker (mini/mini-2) event stream: a decoded, filterable live read of whether the fleet is working or wedged, without ssh. Distinct from the aggregate views (control-loop-live, scheduler-health, ticket-lifecycle) and from the pino-log tail (fleet-daemon-logs). The noise floor ($noise + $noisename) is the primary control — a naive tail is ~75% heartbeats/samples/ticks/reads.

list.name: node
list.label: node
list.description: Worker host filter (host_name). Default = a single node so mirrored webhook events (catalyst.github / catalyst.linear emit on BOTH minis) show once, not twice — defect #2. Widen to All (.*) for a fleet-wide tail — .* not .+ so an event with absent/empty host_name is retained rather than silently dropped during a host-identity or ingestion fault (no such events exist on the worker-classed stream today, but .* costs nothing and fails safe).

list.name: noise
list.label: noise floor (action)
list.description: Suppresses the ~75% event_action noise floor (heartbeat / sampled / tick / read / autotune-gauge / parallelism-sampled). 'signal' hides them; 'all' selects a never-match sentinel so the !~ filter becomes a no-op → raw firehose. Paired with $noisename for undecomposed families (defect #1). Loki ANCHORS label-filter regexes, so each term is wrapped `(.*\.)?(…)` to also catch the dotted-suffix form (host.process.sampled → event_action `process.sampled`); a bare alternation leaks those.

list.name: noisename
list.label: noise floor (name)
list.description: Second noise clause on event_name for legacy / undecomposed families that carry NO event_action — broker.daemon.heartbeat, observability.forward_lag / forward_failed (defect #1). 'all' = never-match sentinel (no-op). Loki ANCHORS label-filter regexes and these names carry a `catalyst.` prefix + `_lag`/`_failed` suffix, so each term is wrapped `.*…*` — a bare alternation matches zero lines and suppresses nothing.

list.name: minsev
list.label: min severity
list.description: Floors the tail on numeric severity_number (INFO=9, WARN=13, ERROR=17). all=1 keeps everything; warn+ hides INFO; errors shows only ERROR.

list.name: search
list.label: search
list.description: Plain-text substring filter over the event body (|= "..."). No regex / backslashes. Empty = all.

list.name: ticket
list.label: ticket
list.description: Filter to a Linear key via | linear_key=~".*<ticket>.*" (substring/regex). Wrapped in .*….* so empty = a true no-op that matches every value INCLUDING absent linear_key — Loki anchors regex label filters (^(?:…)$), so a bare =~"" would match ONLY empty/absent keys and hide every ticketed event. Empty = all.

panels.title: Events / min — $node
panels.description: Non-noise events per MINUTE for this worker (shares the tail's $noise + $noisename floor). Fixed [1m] window, NOT [$__interval] — $__interval tracks the time range, so an interval-windowed count is not a per-minute rate and the same underlying rate would change magnitude under a panel titled 'per min'. Panel REPEATS over $node and the query is a scalar `sum(...) or vector(0)`: Loki emits no sample at all for a silent node (it cannot assert an absent-but-expected series), so a `sum by (host_name)` graph makes a dead worker VANISH rather than read zero. `or vector(0)` forces the 0 line, which is what makes 'node flat at zero' (Gherkin scenario 3) actually observable.

targets.expr: sum (count_over_time({service_name=~"${service:pipe}"} | log_file_name="" | catalyst_node_class="worker" | host_name=~"$node" | event_action!~`${noise}` or severity_number>=17 or linear_read_result="failed" | event_name!~`${noisename}` or severity_number>=17 or linear_read_result="failed" [1m])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Last Seen by Entity / Action
panels.description: TRUE last-seen wall-clock per entity/action — `max_over_time(| unwrap observed_timestamp)` (epoch ns) / 1e6 → epoch ms, rendered as time-ago. A plain count_over_time cannot do this: it says only THAT a family fired in the window, not WHEN, so a family that fired once at the very start is indistinguishable from one firing now. Sorted OLDEST-FIRST, so the family that went quiet is the top row — that is the stopped-signal read (Gherkin scenario 3). Shares the tail's noise floor ($noise/$noisename) so the rows are real families, not the metronome; noise families never stop emitting, so suppressing them costs no stopped-signal coverage. Set $noise/$noisename to 'all' to include them. Caveat inherent to Loki: a family silent for LONGER than the dashboard range has no sample at all and drops out entirely — widen the range to see it.

targets.expr: max by (event_entity, event_action) (max_over_time({service_name=~"${service:pipe}"} | log_file_name="" | catalyst_node_class="worker" | host_name=~"${node:pipe}" | event_action!~`${noise}` or severity_number>=17 or linear_read_result="failed" | event_name!~`${noisename}` or severity_number>=17 or linear_read_result="failed" | unwrap observed_timestamp | __error__="" [$__range])) / 1000000

panels.title: Event Tail
panels.description: Newest-first decoded tail: [host] service · entity/action (label) | body. The $noise + $noisename floor hides the ~75% heartbeat/sample/tick/read noise (both clauses are needed — undecomposed families like broker.daemon.heartbeat carry no event_action, defect #1). Set $noise/$noisename to 'all' for the raw firehose. Empty labels render with no dangling separator (defect #3); undecomposed events fall back to event_name.

targets.expr: {service_name=~"${service:pipe}"} | log_file_name="" | catalyst_node_class="worker" | host_name=~"${node:pipe}" | event_action!~`${noise}` or severity_number>=17 or linear_read_result="failed" | event_name!~`${noisename}` or severity_number>=17 or linear_read_result="failed" | severity_number>=${minsev} | linear_key=~".*${ticket}.*" |= "${search}" | line_format `[{{ .host_name }}] {{ .service_name }} · {{ if .event_entity }}{{ .event_entity }}/{{ .event_action }}{{ else }}{{ .event_name }}{{ end }}{{ if .event_label }} ({{ .event_label }}){{ end }} | {{ __line__ }}`
